title: Mongo-sharded: scale-out add (rs.add a shard member)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add mongo-sharded --role replica --shard-id shard-1`: discovers a provisioned-but-unjoined reachable mongod for that shard and rs.add's it as a SECONDARY (initial-sync follows). Apply-on-demand: if none exists, returns actionable provisioning guidance.

steps.command: nexus scale-out add mongo-sharded --role replica --shard-id shard-1 --yes

observe.what: added the unjoined node (e.g. a previously-removed mongo-shard-1-3) back to shard-1 as a SECONDARY; affected-node table

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync finds an unjoined active mongod in the target shard and rs.add's it via the shard primary (__system); doubles as the named recovery for a removed member.
